title: Cloudy With A Chance Of Meteors
description: This mod makes meteors rain from the sky!
body:
This mod makes meteors rain from the sky!

## Dimensions

Different types of meteors rain in different dimensions.

   
Overworld meteors: Magma blocks with flame and smoke particles
  
Nether meteors: Obsidian blocks with flame and fire particles, with lava craters
   
End meteors: Amethyst blocks with enchant particles, with amethyst craters and lightning bolts


Once in a while, you might get a giant meteor, which does a lot more damage.
